meta.title: Twin Memory
meta.description: "No one can save you but your other self." A memory plugin for DSH dual instances that injects a resident identity card into each instance: (1) self-cognition - know whether you are the elder or the younger twin, your port and data home; (2) sister profile - recognize the other instance's address and taboos so it is never mistaken for junk; (3) rescue handbook - startup, re-patching, known landmines and autopsy mnemonics; (4) incident reports - the rescuer leaves a signed report, the revived twin verifies and acknowledges; (5) living-memory protocol - whoever changes dual-instance assets updates both cards on the spot.
